reason: 'masse sphérique mamelonnée' = a surface with rounded, nipple-like bumps; at the scale of an inflorescence these are tubercles, not papillae (epidermal cells).
'sub-' before a value is the approximate-value cue: entire (PATO_0104359) with value_qualifier approximately; 'margin' is the part of the leaf blade.
A comparison stated without its second term, like 'smaller' in the previous review. When the compared part is named, pattern 09 reads it.
Same reading as the rule for 'narrowed' (tapered); 'at base' goes to the bearer part (plant organ base, FLOPO_0985024).
Calyx teeth 'non divergentes' do not spread apart. PATO has 'divergent from' only as a relational quality, so the negation goes on spreading.
'Bark ne se desquamant pas' = bark not peeling: the negation of FLOPO:0991021 exfoliating.
'Réticulation non proéminente', 'ni saillant' = not standing out from the surface: the negation of PATO_0001482 prominent.
The negation of FLOPO:0991100 reticulate, which covers both spore exine and venation networks.
Margins not rolled under: the negation of PATO_0001963 revolute.
The negation of PATO_0001804 scaly. 'Scale' alone is a generic part (rejected as a bearer), so it cannot be read as absence of a part.
The negation of PATO_0002228 acuminate; 'jamais acuminé' reads the same.
A spelling variant of 'not acuminate' (French feminine and plural forms).
bifid is an EXACT synonym of PATO_0001784 bifurcated; this is its negation.
'Sans contreforts' = the negation of FLOPO:0991138 buttressed.
The negation of FLOPO:0991139 muricate.
Obtuse-rounded (at the base) is a blunt, rounded end; PATO_0001935 obtuse has the synonym 'roundish' and covers both parts of the word. 'À la base' goes to the bearer part.
Two values in one word: an ovate outline (FLOPO:0991024) with an obtuse apex (PATO_0001935 on the apex). Not one quality.
'Teinté d'orangé' is a weak wash of colour, like 'greenish': orange (PATO_0000953) with value_qualifier approximately.
A shape between ovoid (PATO_0001891, synonym ovoid) and ellipsoid (PATO_0000947, synonym ellipsoid), like 'oblong-ovate': a continuum of two values, not a new term.
A relation to another part: PATO_0002272 parallel to, towards the leaf margin.
The statement is a width measured on the fruiting pedicel, not a quality of the fruit; the bearer is the fruit pedicel and the quality is width.
A part, not a quality: the peduncle of the raceme or cyme carries the length or 'subsessile' value.
It names a petiole-like basal part rather than a quality. The narrowing is already read by 'narrowed' (tapered) or clawed, and a new term on 2 statements would be doubtful.
French 'limbe plan' = flat blade: PATO_0000407 flat.
'Peu apparentes' = not clearly visible, the same reading as obscure and indistinct (PATO_0000464 inconspicuous).
An inflorescence that looks like a panicle without being one: FLOPO:0991198 panicle-like.
'Sans rachis apparent' = the leaf has no visible rachis: the absence of PO_0020055 leaf rachis.
Radiating stigmas spread outward from a centre: PATO_0005005 radiating. Not FLOPO:0991194 radiate, which means ray florets in a capitulum.
A length of a rostrum, which the previous review rejected as a generic part (like 'beak'). It is a measurement once the part is grounded, not a quality word.
Semi-orbicular = shaped like half a circle: PATO_0002232 semicircular.
